protocol.title: High-throughput Isolation and Sorting of Gut Microbes Reduce Biases of Traditional Cultivation Strategies
protocol.platform: Anaerobic droplet microfluidics (flow-focusing droplet generation + image-based droplet sorting inside vinyl anaerobic chamber)
sample_types: Mouse gut microbiota (Altered Schaedler's Flora, 8-species model community)
Human fecal microbiota (single FMT donor stool sample)
protocol.objective: High-throughput anaerobic isolation and clonal cultivation of gut bacteria in picoliter droplets, image-based wavelet OD sorting for slow-growing colonies, and 16S rRNA amplicon profiling to demonstrate enrichment of rare taxa over conventional agar plate cultivation

device.housing: Vinyl anaerobic chamber (Coy Laboratory Products), 86% N2 / 10% O2 / 4% H2 gas mixture
device.fabrication: Soft lithography; SU-8 3050 negative photoresist molds on 4-inch silicon wafers

droplet_sorting_device.substrate: PDMS bonded to ITO-coated glass slide (Delta Technologies, CG-811N-S207)
droplet_sorting_device.electrode_material: Low melting-point solder (51% In / 32.5% Bi / 16.5% Sn, Indium Corporation of America)

reagents.carrier_oil: Bio-Rad Droplet Generation Oil for EvaGreen

BHIS.composition: 500 mL water, 18.5 g Brain Heart Infusion Broth (Sigma), 2.5 g yeast extract, 0.25 g L-cysteine, 0.5 mL 0.1% Vitamin K in 95% ethanol, 0.5 mL hemin solution (5 mg/mL in 0.1 M NaOH)

BHIS_ASF.additives: 5% newborn calf serum, 5% sheep serum, 5% horse serum (all Fisher Scientific)

YCFA.composition: 10 g casitone, 2.5 g yeast extract, 5 g dextrose (D-glucose), 0.045 g MgSO4x7H2O, 0.09 g CaCl2x2H2O, 0.45 g K2HPO4, 0.45 g KH2PO4, 0.9 g NaCl, 0.001 g resazurin sodium salt, 1.9 mL acetic acid, 0.7 mL propionic acid, 90 uL isobutyric acid, 100 uL n-valeric acid, 100 uL iso-valeric acid, 500 mL DI water; boiled 10 min, then: 4 g NaHCO3, 0.5 g L-cysteine-HCl, 0.01 g hemin, 0.0025 g mucin; DI water to 990 mL; pH 6.7-6.8; autoclave; then add 10 mL filter-sterilised vitamin solution
YCFA.vitamin_solution_per_L: 2 mg biotin, 2 mg folic acid, 12 mg pyridoxine-HCl, 4.5 mg thiamine-HCl, 5 mg riboflavin, 5 mg nicotinic acid, 5 mg D-Ca-pantothenate, 0.1 mg vitamin B12, 5 mg p-aminobenzoic acid, 5 mg DL-thioctic acid

asf_strains.source: Taconic Biosciences (fecal pellets); pure strains from Dr. Michael Wannemuehler

steps.name: Anaerobic chamber and device priming
steps.notes: FC-40 oil and HFE7500 surfactant flushed through microfluidic channels inside anaerobic chamber to prime device. Channels pre-coated with Aquapel then Fluorinert FC-40 for hydrophobicity. Anaerobic conditions: O2 < 1 ppm, H2 1.5-2.5%, monitored by Coy CAM-12 anaerobic monitor. H2S reducing column placed inside chamber to prevent corrosion of electronic components.

steps.name: ASF fecal pellet preparation and dilution
steps.stock_preparation: Dissociate 3 ASF fecal pellets (Taconic Biosciences) in 5 mL BHIS-ASF medium; sediment fecal solids; collect supernatant; store at -80 C in 25% glycerol / 25% BHIS / 50% cell suspension
steps.missing_strain: ASF 360 (L. intestinalis) not detected by species-specific PCR in fecal pellets
steps.detection_method: Species-specific PCR; primers from Sarma-Rupavtarm et al. (2004)
steps.notes: Pure ASF strains also cultured independently from stock solutions in liquid BHIS-ASF broth for 1-2 days before separate droplet encapsulation experiments.

steps.name: ASF droplet generation
steps.encapsulation_statistics: Poisson: ~20-30% of droplets contain exactly 1 live bacterial cell
steps.notes: All droplet generation performed inside anaerobic chamber. Bacteria stochastically encapsulated by diluting fecal cell suspension in BHIS-ASF medium to achieve single-cell occupancy per Poisson statistics. Oil phase: HFE7500 with surfactant.

steps.name: ASF droplet incubation
steps.notes: Droplet emulsion placed in 37 C incubator inside anaerobic chamber. Isolated viable strains grow clonally within droplets. Droplets prevent competitive overgrowth of fast-growing ASF 361 (L. murinus) over ASF 519 (P. goldsteinii) observed in bulk broth. Extremely oxygen-sensitive strains (ASF 356, 492, 500, 502) maintained at <1 ppm O2 throughout.

steps.name: ASF emulsion break, DNA extraction, and ddPCR quantification
steps.emulsion_break_method: Add equal part PFO to emulsion, vortex, centrifuge, remove oil+PFO phase
steps.dna_extraction: Qiagen DNeasy Blood & Tissue Kit; elution volume 100 uL

quantification.method: Droplet digital PCR (BioRad QX200 ddPCR system)
quantification.thermocycle: 94 C 10 min; 35 cycles: 94 C 1 min, 60 C 1 min, 72 C 2 min
quantification.primers: Species-specific primers from Sarma-Rupavtarm et al. (2004)

expected_results.bulk_broth: ASF 361 (L. murinus) dominates; ASF 519 outcompeted due to parasitism
expected_results.droplets: ASF 361 confined; ASF 457 reaches 34% relative abundance; ASF 519 reaches 0.96%; higher diversity maintained

steps.name: Human stool aliquot preparation
steps.phase: Phase 2 - Human stool cultivation across 3 media
steps.sample_source: Single human stool sample from FMT donor (IRB 132-0212, University of Chicago Institutional Review Board; written informed consent obtained)
steps.aliquot_preparation: Spin down 50 uL stool diluted in 100 uL PBS; carry forward supernatant; store at -80 C
steps.dilution_for_droplets: 200x (to achieve ~20-30% single-cell occupancy per Poisson statistics)
steps.notes: Three independent aliquots dispensed (one per media arm: BHIS, GMM, YCFA) to avoid variable reuse across parallel cultivation branches. Plate controls: 100 uL stool suspension spread onto agar plates, cultured 7 days.

steps.name: BHIS droplet generation and incubation
steps.phase: Phase 2 - Human stool cultivation across 3 media
steps.notes: Brain Heart Infusion Supplemented medium. Parallel agar plate control cultured 7 days. No biological replicate variation detected between replicates or cultivation time for a given condition.

steps.name: GMM droplet generation and incubation
steps.phase: Phase 2 - Human stool cultivation across 3 media
steps.notes: Gut Microbiota Medium prepared per Goodman et al. (2011) PNAS 108:6252.

steps.name: YCFA droplet generation and incubation
steps.phase: Phase 2 - Human stool cultivation across 3 media
steps.notes: Yeast Casitones Fatty Acid medium (modified DSMZ 1611). pH 6.7-6.8.

steps.name: Emulsion break and DNA extraction (all three media arms)
steps.phase: Phase 2 - Human stool cultivation across 3 media
steps.emulsion_break_method: Add equal part PFO, vortex and centrifuge, remove oil+PFO phase
steps.dna_extraction: Qiagen DNeasy Blood & Tissue Kit; elution volume 100 uL

steps.name: 16S rRNA amplicon sequencing and community richness QC gate
steps.phase: Phase 2 - Human stool cultivation across 3 media
steps.operation: detect -> mix -> mix -> detect -> if/else gate

sequencing.facility: Environmental Sample Preparation and Sequencing Facility, Argonne National Laboratory
sequencing.qc: illumina-utils: demultiplex, join pairs (min overlap 45 nt, <2 mismatches in overlap)
sequencing.asv_inference: Minimum Entropy Decomposition (MED) / oligotyping pipeline v2.1

metrics.richness_R: Total count of ASVs per sample
metrics.rlow: Count of ASVs <1% abundant in raw stool that are cultivated
metrics.statistical_test: Mann-Whitney U (wilcox.test in R); null: difference of means = 0

expected_results.bacteroides_clustering: Droplet cultures cluster closer to raw stool than plate cultures (p<0.005, multiscale bootstrap resampling)
expected_results.shannon_diversity: Increased in BHIS and YCFA droplets vs. plates; not in GMM

steps.name: Slow-growing colony droplet sorting preparation and incubation
steps.notes: Fresh human stool aliquot in BHIS medium. Two independent sorting experiments. Droplets reinjected at 20 uL/hr; oil spacing phase at 180 uL/hr.

steps.name: Image-based wavelet OD sorting and sorting QC gate

sorting_system.wavelet_transform: Discrete wavelet frame decomposition (LabView IMAQ Extract Texture Feature VI)

steps.name: Sorted droplet DNA extraction and 16S sequencing
steps.sorted_volume_uL: 1-10 (thin layer on oil; estimated by pipetting)
steps.emulsion_break_method: Add 150 uL DNA-free water + 150 uL PFO to sorted droplets, vortex, centrifuge

expected_results.asvs_amplified_unsorted: 6.5 average (out of 158 total ASVs) amplified from <1% to >1%
expected_results.asvs_amplified_sorted: 12.5 average (out of 158 total ASVs) amplified from <1% to >1%
expected_results.phylogenetic_range: Sorted samples amplify taxa across wider phylogenetic range than unsorted

steps.name: Viability confirmation: agar plate streaking and colony growth
steps.operation: mix -> heat -> mix -> detect -> if/else gate
steps.agar_streak_method: Streak ~10 uL sorted droplet emulsion + oil onto BHIS agar plate; culture 2 days at 37 C

colony_picking.method: Random picking; place each colony into 2 mL BHIS broth
colony_picking.sequencing: Sanger sequencing (27F/1492R primers, GoTaq Green Master Mix, PCR: 95 C 3 min; 30 cycles: 95 C 30 s, 54 C 30 s, 72 C 1 min; 72 C 10 min); excise from 2% agarose gel; QIAquick Gel Extraction Kit; sequence at U. Chicago Comprehensive Cancer Center DNA Sequencing Facility
